messages:
Maria Wong: Morning — async standup for GPU fleet / provisioning.
Maria Wong: Yesterday: finished the regional quota map for eu-central-1, kicked off a small prewarm for the ded-pool there; validated health checks.
Maria Wong: Blockers: AWS quota increase for A100/H100 still pending (support case opened but no ETA). Also found a reservation conflict with existing Dedicated commitments (finance needs to approve reassignment).
Maria Wong: Today: follow up with cloud-ops support, coordinate finance note, and start a canary in us-west1 if quotas clear.
Aj Patel: Thx. I freed 4 x A100-80GB nodes in us-west1 this morning so the queue is stable for the next 2h. Will monitor.
Aj Patel: I'm also preparing an H100 quota request for us-east-1 (dedicated burst pool). Will submit after Priya confirms exact SKUs.
Ryan Chen: Observed ~20% cold-start rate for prewarms in eu-west-1 yesterday, likely KV cache not warming for some prefixes. I'll run a KV cache scrub and tweak the warmup set.
Priya Singh: @Maria please send exact SKU/region/AZs for the quota request so I can file the vendor portal request.
Maria Wong: SKU details: A100-80GB (sku: a100_80), H100-80GB (sku: h100_80). Regions: eu-central-1 (eu-central-1a/b/c), us-west1 (a/b), us-east-1 (a/c).
infra-bot: autoscaler: high-queue alert at 09:12 UTC in us-east-1 — scaled +6 GPUs to ded-pool-d2. (rule: queue-depth>250)
Aj Patel: noted infra-bot. I added tag `dedicated-prewarm` to the new nodes so they follow prewarm policies.
Priya Singh: Filed support ticket AWS-QUOTA-7892 for A100 in eu-central-1, case link: https://console.aws.amazon.com/support/cases#/case/?caseId=AWS-QUOTA-7892 — ETA 48-72h.
Ryan Chen: Quick ask — can someone review the prewarm script CR? small bash tweak to wait on KV mount.
Ryan Chen: https://git.redwood/infra/prewarm/merge/321 (just one-liner change)
Aj Patel: I'll take a look, should be quick. Aim to merge by EOD. :thumbsup:
Maria Wong: Blocker: reservation conflict — @Priya can you escalate to finance? We need to reassign one monthly commitment to the dedicated pool for Q2.
Priya Singh: On it. Drafting a short note to finance and adding cost delta. Will ping here once submitted.
Aj Patel: Ops note — when draining GPU nodes for reprovisioning, use the safe drain command:
```
redwoodctl node drain <node> --grace 120 --wait-kv
```
This avoids KV cache eviction during in-flight requests.
Maria Wong: Good call. Also remind on fallback policy: if quota isn't ready by canary window, we'll fallback to hosted variants and run perf comparisons.
Ryan Chen: I'll run the diagnostic sweep tonight at 22:00 UTC (may cause brief API 502s). Posting log link after run.
infra-bot: maintenance scheduled: diagnostic-sweep at 22:00 UTC for fleet health checks — expected impact: transient 502s for internal control plane (20m).
Maria Wong: Thanks team. No more items from me. Will update when quota / finance moves.
Aj Patel: Thanks all — will post if queue spikes.
Ryan Chen: End of thread — will report post-sweep.
